method: 5 perspective-diverse independent reviewers (re-derivation, alt-deconfounded-rankers, metric-interpretation, leak-validity, steelman-opposite) re-derived from the 8041-candidate table (no torch) + 1 synthesis. Workflow gap3-stage0-adversarial-verify.

reviewer_verdicts.best_alt_ranker_found: None beats vote on a de-confounded basis. Q_MAX ties vote at pass@2=0.4516 (14/31) but its 14 hits are EXACTLY the 14 vote hits (overlap=14, zero unique gains, zero unique losses) — it is frequency-in-disguise, not a vote-orthogonal signal. Every truly de-confounded ranker I tried collapses far below vote: within-task residual p@2=0.0645, global q_mean-residual 0.0968, rank-residual (qrank-voterank) 0.1290, q_max global-residual 0.0323. The only two rankers >vote (HYBRID 0.4839, Q_LSE 0.4839) beat it by exactly +1 task and are vote-primary or vote-confounded: I independently confirmed Pearson(q_lse,votes)=0.476, so Q_LSE's edge is mechanically driven by sample count (logsumexp over `votes` samples), not model-native confidence.

reviewer_verdicts.best_alt_ranker_found: top-3-vote-shortlist-then-q_mean = 0.5161 (16/31), beats vote by +2 tasks BUT is vote-confounded by construction (vote builds the shortlist), NOT a primary signal. It is a single-K spike (K=2->0.452, K=3->0.516, K=4->0.484, K>=5->0.452, all collapse back), bootstrap CI [0.0000, 0.1613] touches zero with 12.5% of resamples <=0, and rescues 2 tasks purely by tie-breaking a vote-rank-3 gold upward. This is the HYBRID/deployment-refinement category the artifact already flags, not model-native PRIMARY signal. The best TRULY vote-orthogonal PRIMARY ranker is q_max = 0.4516 (ties vote, does not beat it); pure q_mean = 0.2903.

None beats vote on the merits. The only rankers reaching 0.4839 (Q_LSE, HYBRID vote->qmean, and additive blends at small q-weight w<=0.05) are all vote-PRIMARY with q as a tie-breaker only; the +1-task gain (1/31 = 0.032, inside the bootstrap noise band) is the deployment nicety the artifact already flags. Every genuinely vote-orthogonal/deconfounded q ranker is WORSE than vote: Q_MEAN 0.2903, Q_MAX 0.4516 (ties, not beats), within-task z-scored q_mean 0.2903, q_mean residual-over-vote 0.0968, q_lse residual-over-vote 0.1613. q-PRIMARY (qmean-then-vote) = 0.2903. No w in the additive blend sweep ever exceeds 0.4839, and 0.4839 only holds while vote dominates.

reviewer_verdicts.best_alt_ranker_found: No vote-orthogonal q ranker BEATS vote. The best de-confounded q ranker is Q_MAX at pass@2=0.4516, which exactly TIES vote (14/31). I verified Q_MAX is genuinely vote-orthogonal: pure Q_MAX with no vote tie-break = 0.4516, and even anti-vote tie-break (prefer fewer votes on q_max ties) = 0.4516, with zero top-2 q_max ties across all 31 tasks — so the 0.4516 is real q_max signal, but it only reaches parity, never exceeds vote. Additional vote-orthogonal aggregations I tried that the experiment did NOT (vote-normalized log-mean-exp = q_lse - log(votes) = 0.2903; q_mean*q_max = 0.3226; q_max-q_mean spread = 0.0645-0.1935) all fail to beat vote. The two rankers that DO beat vote (Q_LSE 0.4839, HYBRID 0.4839) are exactly the confounded ones: I measured within-task spearman(q_lse,votes)=0.7496 (vs q_mean's 0.4448), confirming Q_LSE is frequency in disguise, and HYBRID's win is a vote-primary tie-break (+1 task).

None beats vote on a de-confounded basis. The only q rankers reaching 0.4839 are HYBRID(vote-primary, q_mean tiebreak) and PRIMARY q_lse — both vote-confounded. q_lse is logsumexp over per-candidate q, structurally monotone in candidate count (=votes), so it is vote-confounded by construction, not model-native. Every genuinely vote-orthogonal q primary ranker is WORSE than vote@2 (0.4516): q_mean 0.2903, q_max 0.4516 (ties, no gain), min_defined 0.3871, union_max 0.1935, q_mean-residual-over-vote 0.0968. A confidence GATE (accept vote-top1 if q_mean>=0.99) reaches 5/19 at 100% accuracy but adds zero new correct answers and is a tiny-n precision/coverage tradeoff, not a selection win.

required_fixes: Cosmetic only (non-blocking): the prompt brief slightly misstates which ranker is the de-confounded headline. The committed artifact names Q_MAX (0.4516, which TIES vote) as best_deconfounded, while the brief frames Q_MEAN (0.2903). Neither beats vote, so the conclusion is unaffected, but align the brief's wording with the artifact for the record.

Cosmetic only (non-blocking): Q_MAX is labeled 'best_deconfounded_q_ranker' yet provides ZERO orthogonal lift (its 14-hit set is byte-identical to vote's). The artifact's prose is honest (model_native_signal_real=false), but consider renaming to 'best_q_ranker_at_parity' to avoid implying Q_MAX adds selection value it does not.
synthesis.summary: The Stage-0 negative is CONFIRMED on the merits. I independently re-derived every headline number from the raw 8041-candidate table with system python3 (no torch): VOTE pass@2=0.4516, Q_MEAN=0.2903 (worse), Q_MAX=0.4516 (ties, zero orthogonal lift — its hit set is byte-identical to vote's), Q_LSE=0.4839 and HYBRID=0.4839 (both +1 task, both vote-confounded), Q_MEAN_residual_over_vote=0.0968, oracle=0.6129, bootstrap point -0.1613 CI95 [-0.290,-0.032] with 99.3% of resamples negative, within-task AUROC 0.856 vs between-task-inflated pooled 0.966 — all match the committed artifact. No reviewer found a de-confounded q ranker that beats vote, and I confirmed this against extra orthogonal constructions: the one alt-ranker that superficially beat vote (q_lse-log(votes+1)=0.516, +2 tasks) remains vote-correlated within-task (spearman 0.58), collapses to 0.161 when residualized over votes, and its bootstrap CI [0.000,0.161] touches zero (12.5% of resamples ≤0), driven by the same lucky-tiebreak tasks the steelman exposed (HYBRID's +1 win on c3202e5a is a coin-flip on a 15-vote tie, P(random tiebreak achieves it)≈0.5). Decisively, headroom_capture_fraction=0: of the 4 tasks where gold is present but vote misses top-2, q_mean recovers exactly zero — the soft scalar signal is entirely redundant with vote where it would need to add value. The positive control holds (oracle 0.613 > vote 0.452 = ~16pp real selectable headroom), so this is an honest negative, not a degenerate no-headroom test. No leak (gold label used only in scoring/AUROC, never in a sort key). Worst issue found is cosmetic naming generosity around Q_MAX. The scalar q_halt collapse to a 1-D projection justifies advancing to Stage 1 (full penultimate latent). GO.
